market: Marine Seismic Data Processing Services Market
market_definition: Service providers that process, image, and interpret marine (offshore) seismic datasets for hydrocarbon exploration and appraisal, encompassing advanced imaging techniques including Full Waveform Inversion (FWI), Reverse Time Migration (RTM), Least-Squares Migration, Depth Imaging, Velocity Model Building, Multiple Attenuation, and Broadband Processing. This excludes standalone software/license vendors who do not themselves execute processing services on client data.
qualifying_services: Geophysical data processing performed on client datasets
excluded_categories: Standalone seismic software vendors that only sell/license software
Software/platform vendors that do not themselves execute processing services on client data
Equipment manufacturers, marine seismic equipment suppliers, seismic acquisition equipment suppliers, hardware suppliers
Data vendors that only sell/license seismic datasets
Multi-client seismic companies that only acquire/license seismic data
Oil & gas companies that only use seismic processing internally
Companies that only perform seismic acquisition without processing
Companies that only provide marine surveys without processing
Market-research firms, news/media companies, industry associations, universities, research institutes, government agencies
Companies whose marine seismic processing activity cannot be verified
Companies that only provide onshore seismic processing with no marine/offshore processing capability
